title: SourceInventory
description: Canonical inventory for a cancer-buddy-organize run. It records each user-supplied source file, the adapter path used only to make it LLM-readable, the text-masked MD sidecar generated by the LLM, and the deep-link from each sidecar (content unit) back to its verbatim original in raw/. Adapter output is provenance only and is never a clinical text source. Uploaded originals in raw/ are kept verbatim and are never pixel-redacted (see bucket-taxonomy.md §4–§5).

patient_dir.description: Absolute path to <patient_dir>. All relative paths below resolve under this directory.

file_id.description: Stable id of this content unit (1:1 with the sidecar/MD), e.g. f001. N content units may share one source_id when a single upload yields multiple sidecars. See bucket-taxonomy.md §4.

source_id.description: Stable per-upload id, e.g. s001. 1:1 with an uploaded original in raw/; N content units may share it.

original_path.description: Original user-supplied path or archive-relative path recorded for audit. May be absolute or logical; never used as an anchor.

raw_path.description: Path to the verbatim un-redacted original under patient_dir/raw/ (hidden, never-anchored vault). Original sub-folder structure and basename preserved. Never pixel-redacted. The frontend deep-links a sidecar back to its original here. See bucket-taxonomy.md §4.

page_range.description: Which pages of a multi-document source this content unit covers, e.g. "3-5". Null when the sidecar covers the whole file.

bucket_path.description: Canonical bucket-relative source-file path after Phase2 classification (clinical domain 01_…14_). Null before classification or for isolated unrelated files.

sidecar_path.description: Bucket-relative text-masked MD sidecar generated by LLM ingestion and co-located in its clinical-domain bucket. The retired ocr/ prefix is invalid for final archives.

modality.description: Orthogonal data-nature tag (independent of the clinical-domain bucket) driving ingest-parser dispatch. text=prose/OCR doc; image=imaging/scan stub; structured=tabular numeric report; omics_raw=VCF/BAM/FASTQ/expression matrix; timeseries=wearable/PRO/longitudinal stream → longitudinal_observations.json; binary_other=opaque/unsupported binary (stub + [INGESTION_BLOCKED], never silently dropped). See bucket-taxonomy.md §2.

read_mode.description: How the LLM received the source content. In all modes the LLM, not a dumb OCR/parser, writes the final text-masked MD.

adapter.description: Format adapter used only to make the source LLM-readable.

adapter_provenance.description: Short provenance such as decode_tool=sips;rotation=90 or pdftoppm pages=3. Temporary paths are allowed only as provenance, never as anchors.

persist.description: Whether this source file is selected for final archive/persist. Medical sources cited by formal outputs (timeline/case_text/review outputs/structured JSON source_refs) must be true; false is reserved for isolated unrelated/non-persisted sources.
